maintenance_led.reason: Writes commercial residential property insurance policies in Florida (condo, HOA, apartment, assisted living); not repair or replacement services.

publicly_funded.reason: Premiums paid by condo associations, HOAs, apartment and assisted living owners, which are private customers, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by writing policies through exclusive MGAs AmRisc and Skyway, not through a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Property policies are placed by brokers and renewed annually; customers can move to other admitted or surplus-lines carriers.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgment call: coverage is needed, but customers can switch carriers at renewal.
